votes.motion: Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to close the staff meeting and go into the public meeting
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to open the hearing for the 2019 recommended budget
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to close the public hearing
Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to approve the minutes of the Magna Metro Township meetings held on October 9, 2018, and October 23, 2018
Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve Resolution 18-12-02 of the Magna Metro Township Council adopting the 2019 Magna Metro Township budget

Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve Resolution 18-12-03 of the Magna Metro Township Council adopting the 2019 Magna consolidated fee schedule, with the amendment that an additional $750 Annexation Fee be added as a fee to new applicants applying for annexation
Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to open the public hearing
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to close the public hearing

Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to approve Ordinance #18-12-01 creating Chapter 16.01 – Inland Port Authority District for the purpose of managing the land use process for properties located in the Utah Inland Port, pursuant to Utah Code § 11-58: “Utah Inland Port Authority Act
